tools.xax_execute: Android ARM64 static-ELF preview: builds only the current authorized canonical request and runs its artifact on the host-selected ADB device through native XAX Windows and Android launchers. Requires --allow-execute plus host-owned XAX_MCP_ADB and XAX_MCP_ANDROID_SERIAL; clients cannot choose a device, path, executable, environment, grant or budget. Optional stdin_hex supplies at most 262144 exact binary bytes followed by EOF; args excludes the controlled argv[0], preserves empty strings and Unicode, and is limited to 64 arguments and 8192 UTF-16 units. The worker has an empty environment, a syscall allowlist that denies file opening, networking and process creation, a five-second CPU limit, ten-second wall timer and 256 MiB virtual address-space limit. Returns separate exact streams, low-eight-bit exit or 128+signal, measured wall/user/kernel CPU and peak RSS bytes, and stdin_bytes_supplied. At most 1 MiB combined output is returned; device spool is bounded at 2 MiB plus two bytes and over-limit output is withheld. Setup, incomplete transport, budget and cleanup failures fail closed. Device trust, remote disconnect/cancellation cleanup, workspace aliases and wider security gates remain experimental. APKs, shared libraries, Android APIs, typed layouts and external tools are unsupported by this execution profile.
